Automated and manual testing of developed applications (Web and Windows apps).

4+ years of professional experience in software testing.
Automation testing experience (Typescript/JavaScript/ Python/ Java/ C#).
AI Agentic coding (Claude AI, Claude Skills, MCP).
Experience with Playwright.
Experience with web services and API testing.
Technical skills regarding network communication.
Web testing experience: REST API, HTTP requests, browser developer console.
Experience using Bug Reporting Tools (ex: JIRA).
Experience using 3rd party tools for troubleshooting and testing.
Deductive reasoning and critical thinking with ability to relate from end-user perspective.
Nice to have basic technical skills in databases (MSSQL/ MongoDB).
Nice to have ISTQB certification or similar.
Oral and written English communication skills.
